messages:
dina: quick thread — A/B for v7-candidate (fp16 -> int4) shows an odd discrepancy driven by tokenization boundary shifts when prompts include mixed languages. opening to define gated rollback thresholds.
sam: what metrics? slice size, MRR, QA F1, latency.
dina: multi-lang slice (mix en+zh + emoji) n=4.9k, MRR -1.6% vs baseline, QA F1 -1.1, hallucination +0.5. global n=120k, global MRR -0.12. p95 latency multi-lang +60ms. note: tokenizer reports increased token count ~+8% for some prompts.
yusuf: tokenizer shift could change receptive windows and KV alignment. propose an entropy-weighted composite signal that combines MRR delta and token-count inflation normalized by seq-length variance. trigger auto-rollback if composite_score crosses threshold.
sam: define composite_score: (mrr_drop_pct * 1.0) + (token_inflation_pct * 0.6) + (hallucination_pct * 1.2). trigger if >= 1.8 AND samples>=3000 AND sustained 15m.
dina: also add per-customer SLA guard: if any paid-SLA customer sees MRR drop >=0.7% for 10m -> immediate rollback for that cohort. page owners for smaller customers.
policy-bot: canary id can-175111 started 1751114000 routing=6%. smoke: 88/92, failing cases enriched in multi-lang slice.
ops-bot: enabling 24h shadow-run for can-175111, pausing further promotion until we have more signals.
dina: dropping rollout JSON for ops to ingest:

```json
{"rollout_policy":"v7-int4-candidate","auto_fallback":{"composite_threshold":1.8,"persistence_mins":15,"min_samples":3000,"components":{"mrr_weight":1.0,"token_inflation_weight":0.6,"hallucination_weight":1.2}},"slices":{"multi_lang":{"sensitivity_mult":1.3}},"per_customer_sla":{"mrr_drop_pct":0.7,"persistence_mins":10,"immediate":true},"watch_only":{"global_mrr_pct":0.35}}
```

sam: also add a margin: require composite_score > 1.8 AND composite_score > 1.4 * stderr_composite to reduce noisy flips.
yusuf: I'll run a targeted bootstrap that recomputes token-inflation distribution and composite stderr. ETA ~25m.
dina: action items: 1) ops enable 24h shadow and wire per-customer SLA alerts; 2) policy to push composite logic to rollout controller; 3) yusuf runs bootstrap; 4) pause promotion beyond 6% until green.
yusuf: bootstrap result: composite_score=1.95, stderr=0.28 -> 1.95 > 1.4*0.28 (0.392) and samples=4.9k. filing auto-rollback if not improved in 8m.
dina: rolling back per policy. ops-bot execute rollback.
ops-bot: rolling back canary can-175111: routing 6% -> 0% starting 1751118540. status: in-progress.
dina: follow-up: add tokenizer regression test to preflight and include multi-lang prompts in canary smoke sets. tagging infra and devex teams.
